name: Fashion Show Mall
summary: Large mall with over 200 shops, 6 department stores & numerous eateries, plus weekly fashion shows.
demographics: Fashion Show Mall attracts a diverse and affluent visitor base combining international tourists and affluent local residents, with a strong representation of middle to upper-income shoppers aged 25-54. The trade area encompasses both the high-traffic Las Vegas Strip tourism market and surrounding residential communities, drawing fashion-conscious consumers with above-average household incomes seeking premium retail experiences. Typical visitors include destination shoppers, convention attendees, and entertainment-seeking tourists who value variety, convenience, and the prestige of shopping at the Strip's largest retail destination.
description: Fashion Show Mall stands as the largest shopping, dining and entertainment destination on the iconic Las Vegas Strip, offering an unparalleled retail experience that brings the culture of fashion to life. Spanning an impressive 2 million square feet, this premier destination features an eclectic mix of more than 250 retailers and over 30 restaurants, catering to locals, visitors, and fashion enthusiasts from around the world. The center's name reflects its unique identity as more than just a shopping venue—it's a destination where fashion meets entertainment through never-before-seen experiences and seasonal events. Located at 3200 Las Vegas Boulevard South, Fashion Show Mall benefits from its prime Strip location, offering convenient parking and pet-friendly policies that enhance the shopping experience. With extended holiday hours and a diverse tenant mix ranging from luxury retailers to dining destinations, Fashion Show Mall has established itself as a must-visit destination that captures the excitement and glamour of Las Vegas shopping.
